members.name: key
members.doc: Stable identity, such as an ISO timestamp.

members.name: label
members.doc: Full label for screen readers, such as "Nov 10, 10:35".

members.name: axisLabel
members.doc: Short label under the price line, such as "10:00". Leave it out on most points to keep the axis quiet.

members.name: volume
members.doc: Volume traded in this interval. It is added to the price level the price falls in.

types.name: VolumeProfileProps
types.doc: Use a volume profile to show at which prices trading concentrated, next to how the price moved over time.

members.name: data
members.doc: Trades or intervals in time order, oldest first.

members.name: label
members.doc: What is traded, such as "Northwind Corp." Names the chart for assistive technology and heads the readout.

members.name: levels
members.doc: Number of price levels the range is split into.

members.name: valueArea
members.doc: Share of the total volume that defines the value area around the point of control, from 0 to 1.

members.name: formatPrice
members.doc: Formats prices on the axis, in the header and in the tooltip.

members.name: formatVolume
members.doc: Formats volumes in the header and in the tooltip.

members.name: hideHeader
members.doc: Hides the headline with the point of control and the value area.

members.name: activeLevel
members.doc: Controlled index of the price level in focus, counted from the lowest price, or null for none.

members.name: defaultActiveLevel
members.doc: Price level in focus on first render when uncontrolled.

members.name: onActiveChange
members.doc: Called when hover, touch or the keyboard moves to another price level, or leaves the plot.

members.name: className
members.doc: Extra class on the root figure.
